Meet the Star

This is Ecko.

Ecko9 is New York through a dog's eyes — the daily life of a city dog, and the guide to doing the city with yours.

Ecko is the face of the account — a brindle Frenchie who inspects every stoop, pauses at every crosswalk, and knows which doorman keeps the treats. He has never once pretended to be anything he isn't.

Every day around midday, a new post: a walk, a café window worth staring at, a leaf pile that needed a professional. That's the whole job, and he takes it seriously.
